name: Kanzanji Rei
source:
The school's queen of cross dressing.
An honor student known of throughout the school, he is especially popular with the girls and is always surrounded by them. He actually likes girls and only cross dresses because it makes him popular with them.

While many think his family is rich he actually poor and has a part time job to help out his family. He lives in the same neighborhood as Chiharu so he gets along well with him.

After a certain incident with Masato they are on bad terms and because Masato makes him conscious of how girl-like he is he can't get along with him. He is chosen as one of Masato's lovers for the project but does everything he can to avoid him.
